These questions change annually, are updated, and published in the summer. The essays are an opportunity to tell us about yourself in your unique voice. There are no right or wrong answers but we do have some advice: Remember, Caltech is an unapologetic STEM institution . Literally, there is no way to write about too much STEM in your supplemental questions. So lean all the way in on the STEMiest of STEMmy topics (yep, those are made-up words but totally appropriate).
